name: Rachel McAdams
summary: An actress with no stated party affiliation or endorsements found. Her documented public activism is mostly environmental (renewable energy, farmland and water protection, old-growth logging, a pipeline protest), plus attendance at immigration and Occupy demonstrations. These are participation in causes, not statements on the test's specific statements.
